scenes.dialogue: Hi, I am Ravishankar from LawWorld. Can land be acquired for a housing society when the Government approved only its request, not a real housing scheme?
Twenty sixth October, twenty twenty six: the Supreme Court bench of Honourable Justice J B Pardiwala and Honourable Justice K Vinod Chandran ruled.
scenes.shown: 26 October 2026: the Supreme Court bench of Honourable Justice J.B. Pardiwala and Honourable Justice K. Vinod Chandran ruled.

scenes.dialogue: A Bengaluru housing society signed an agreement in September nineteen eighty four: a third party would get land acquired for it through the Government.
scenes.shown: A Bengaluru housing society signed an agreement in September 1984: a third party would get land acquired for it through the Government.

scenes.dialogue: Three days later, Section Three f six made a society's housing scheme a public purpose, with prior Government approval. An approval letter came in eighty seven.
scenes.shown: Three days later, Section 3(f)(vi) made a society's housing scheme a public purpose, with prior Government approval. An approval letter came in 1987.

scenes.dialogue: These landowners challenged it only in two thousand seven. A Single Judge quashed it for fraud; the Division Bench reversed, on delay and res judicata.
scenes.shown: These landowners challenged it only in 2007. A Single Judge quashed it for fraud; the Division Bench reversed, on delay and res judicata.

scenes.dialogue: The Supreme Court disagreed. Under Section Three f six, the Government must approve the scheme itself, with its layout and blueprint, not the society's mere requisition.
scenes.shown: The Supreme Court disagreed. Under Section 3(f)(vi), the Government must approve the scheme itself, with its layout and blueprint, not the society's mere requisition.

scenes.dialogue: Here, no layout was placed before the Government, only a sketch of the land. And the agreement, signed before such schemes were a public purpose, exposed the fraud.
Fraud vitiates all solemn acts, the Court said, and res judicata and delay pale into insignificance. The Single Judge's order is restored.
scenes.shown: "Fraud vitiates all solemn acts," the Court said, and res judicata and delay pale into insignificance. The Single Judge's order is restored.

scenes.dialogue: All owners get their land back on refunding the compensation, without interest. Plots not taken back will be auctioned, and the proceeds go to victim compensation.
